attaches.why: Tanya and Tina explicitly reaffirm that sequential one-site-at-a-time rollout remains the fixed, invariant cutover strategy even as the soak duration between sites is recalculated.

position_revisions.why: Tina retracts her earlier two-week soak mandate after discovering the Dockside exception queue delay was caused by a retired weekly batch reconciliation job rather than site settling time; continuous reconciliation on the new platform reduces the empirically verified soak baseline to one week, which Tanya formally adopts to supersede prior guidance while Xavier notes the tighter margin.
